A prescription digital therapeutic that delivers clinically validated treatment to patients is treated as a medical device under both the European Union Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR 2021/820) and the United Kingdom’s post‑Brexit UK Medical Devices Regulations 2023. Under the General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR) and the UK GDPR, health data constitutes a special category of personal information.
